about: A researcher and a writer answer which building is the tallest in the world, with no web search. Both run on Anthropic Fast.
how: A chain of two agents; search is off, so the researcher answers from what the model knows.
learns: Without search a run is cheap and fast, but the answer has no sources behind it.
watch: The input of the run: about 600 tokens. Compare with the twin that may search.
